responsibility: Collects declarations for M32R backend routines implemented in m32r.cc that are referenced from the machine description and other target code but cannot conveniently live in m32r.h. It exposes prologue/epilogue and frame helpers, PIC and trampoline support, compare/conditional-move and block-move emitters, address and operand predicates, return-address and symbol helpers, and register-renaming checks, forming the interface between generated md code and the hand-written target implementation.
